test: test:sdk-host; NotificationsApiTests; DialogsFactoryTests; MainViewApiTests; HostApiTests; NotificationServiceHostTests
notes: Adds the host-facing notification, dialog and main-view layer in Playnite.Core.Hosting with no UI toolkit dependency: INotificationsAPI (publish, id dedupe, dismiss), IDialogsFactory (typed asynchronous request/response) and IMainViewAPI (shell state, selection, filtered games), each behind an injectable host. A missing host is a normal degraded mode with a diagnostic and never throws at startup; HostApis records one diagnostic per missing host. Cancellation is explicit and rethrown. The p5-007a desktop notification service is adapted by Playnite.Platform.DesktopIntegration.NotificationServiceHost. Fake-host contract tests cover publish/dedupe/dismiss, dialog request/response, cancellation, host failure and the fully degraded set; zero skips. The v10-named interfaces live in Core for now because Abstractions PublicAPI.Shipped/Unshipped and the api-baseline are protected; p6-008 owns that freeze. No Avalonia reference, no protected oracle, baseline or aggregate edit.
